description: This file defines classes and templates for managing web transfer operations over WebLinkType connections, including client and server transfer types with support for file handling, hashing, and request/response processing within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a single element instance with reference counting, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including uploading, downloading, and info collection, with internal channel management.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests for file storage and retrieval, with authorization support.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a local destination.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up remote connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.
